headline: Flat revenue, margin pressure drags profit lower
summary_short: Q2 net sales were $1,692.3M, up 0.5% y/y (organic sales -0.4%) as gross margin contracted 120bp; net income fell 41.1% y/y to $38.1M and diluted EPS fell 33.3% y/y to $0.06.
summary_long: Net sales rose 0.5% y/y (organic -0.4%) as VWR Distribution & Services growth (+2.7%, driven by controlled-environment consumables and specialty procurement) offset a Bioscience & Medtech Products decline (-5.1%, lower Fluid Handling and NuSil volumes). Gross margin contracted 120bp y/y on unfavorable mix, inflation and lower volumes, pulling operating income down 5.4% and Adjusted EBITDA down 9.1%. SG&A fell on the absence of prior-year transformation costs. Net income fell 41.1% y/y to $38.1M on lower operating income and higher tax expense, partly offset by lower interest expense from debt paydown. Cash was $306.8M; the company repaid $102.5M on its Euro term loan in the quarter, and no shares were repurchased, leaving $425M still authorized for buybacks.

drivers.explanation: Sales grew on higher volumes and commercial execution in VWR Distribution & Services plus a favorable currency impact, partly offset by softer Bioscience & Medtech Products volumes.
Gross margin fell on unfavorable product mix, inflationary cost pressure and lower sales volumes across the business.
Lower gross profit drove the decline, partly offset by reduced SG&A following the absence of last year's transformation costs; unfavorable FX also weighed on SG&A.
Adjusted EBITDA fell primarily on lower gross profit, with a modest favorable currency offset; GAAP EBITDA moved in the same direction.
Lower operating income and higher income tax expense drove the decline, partly offset by lower interest expense from debt repayments made over the trailing year.
